_comment: email -> {role, queues}. role: admin|member|contractor. queues: scope list, ['*'] = all. Which projects a person covers is not set here: Orient asks the Library on every request (library_client.person_scope). No entry -> a bare contractor (read-tier bundle only, no write-plane access). Template for roles.json, which is gitignored: copy it into ORIENT_CONFIG_ROOT as roles.json. Access-control data — never paste its contents into logs or PR bodies.
